correctness.rationale: Normalizing diagonal-translation orbits converts each orbit to a zero-sum color triple. Tri-colored sum-freeness makes coordinate lists injective and forces any hypothetical unseparated column triple to yield a forbidden off-diagonal zero-sum equation. Conversely, PHF separation plus translation closure forces coordinate injectivity and excludes every off-diagonal zero-sum relation. The F_81 specialization is independently verified by a finite exhaustive collision-graph check.

originality.rationale: Walker-Colbourn's cyclic progression-free construction is recovered as a special diagonal tri-colored seed, while Shangguan-Ge and Wei-Zhang-Ge establish neighboring additive/hypergraph PHF constructions. Searches did not locate the exact equivalence between arbitrary diagonal-translation-developed three-row PHFs and tri-colored sum-free sets, nor the resulting exact structured capacity. Originality remains to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from alternative group-developed or induced-matching terminology and inaccessible historical PHF tables.

value.rationale: The result exactly characterizes a natural symmetry class rather than merely adding one construction. It transfers sharp tri-colored sum-free asymptotics to PHFs and proves that diagonal translation symmetry incurs a fixed polynomial exponent loss relative to unrestricted near-quadratic three-row PHFs in fixed characteristic. It also gives a concrete verified PHF(3;1620,81,3).
